command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
echo "== minimap2 -ax map-hifi, 217,281 PacBio HiFi reads (2.16 Gbp) vs chr20 =="
minimap2 --version
T0=$(date +%s)
minimap2 -ax map-hifi -t 16 --MD chr20.fa hifi.chr20.fq.gz 2> minimap2.log | gzip -1 > aln.sam.gz
T1=$(date +%s)
WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))

echo "== stats from the SAM itself =="
# Flag bits by arithmetic, not and(): gawk's and() is not portable across awk builds.
# All counters are floating point -- 2.16 Gbp overflows awk's %d (int32) at real scale.
zcat aln.sam.gz | awk '
  !/^@/ {
    f=$2
    if (int(f/256)%2 || int(f/2048)%2) next          # skip secondary (0x100) / supplementary (0x800)
    prim++
    if ($3=="*") { unmapped++; next }
    mapped++
    if ($3!="chr20") offchr++
    bl=0; n=""
    for (i=1;i<=length($6);i++) {
      ch=substr($6,i,1)
      if (ch ~ /[0-9]/) n=n ch
      else { v=n+0; n=""; if (ch=="M"||ch=="I"||ch=="D"||ch=="="||ch=="X") bl+=v }
    }
    nm=-1
    for (i=12;i<=NF;i++) if ($i ~ /^NM:i:/) { split($i,a,":"); nm=a[3]+0 }
    if (nm>=0 && bl>0) { totbl+=bl; totnm+=nm; idn++ }
  }
  END {
    printf "primary %.0f\nmapped %.0f\nunmapped %.0f\noffchr %.0f\n", prim, mapped, unmapped, offchr
    printf "pct_mapped %.3f\n", 100*mapped/prim
    printf "mean_identity %.4f\n", 100*(1 - totnm/totbl)
    printf "aln_bases %.0f\n", totbl
  }' > st.txt
cat st.txt
g(){ awk -v k="$1" '$1==k{print $2}' st.txt; }
PRIM=$(g primary); MAPPED=$(g mapped); OFFCHR=$(g offchr)
PCTMAP=$(g pct_mapped); IDENT=$(g mean_identity); ALNB=$(g aln_bases)
BYTES=$(stat -c%s aln.sam.gz)
{
  echo "minimap2_preset   map-hifi"
  echo "wall_s            $WALL  (the aligner only)"
  echo "primary_records   $PRIM  want 217281 (one per input read)"
  echo "pct_mapped        $PCTMAP  want >=95 (reads drawn from chr20 alignments)"
  echo "mean_identity     $IDENT %  want >=98 (HiFi vs GRCh38; see note on why not 99)"
  echo "off_chr20         $OFFCHR  want 0"
  echo "aligned_bases     $ALNB"
  echo "aln_sam_gz_bytes  $BYTES"
} > smoke-check.txt
cat smoke-check.txt
# One primary record per input read is a conservation identity: minimap2 must account for
# every read exactly once, mapped or not.
test "$PRIM" = '217281'
test "$OFFCHR" = '0'
# Floors justified, not shaved. Identity here is alignment identity against GRCh38, which is
# NOT the platform's advertised read accuracy: it also absorbs genuine NA12878-vs-reference
# variation (~1 per 1000 bp) and indel representation. HiFi's "Q20 / 99%" is a claim about reads
# against their true molecule, so asserting 99% here conflates two quantities. 98% is the bar a
# HiFi alignment must clear -- ONT R9 sits near 92-95%, Illumina near 99.5% -- so it separates
# "HiFi aligned correctly" from wrong data or a broken index, with real margin.
awk -v v="$IDENT"  'BEGIN{exit !(v>=98)}'
# Not every read pbmm2 placed on chr20 maps back confidently against chr20 alone: repeat-rich and
# pericentromeric reads are exactly the ones a different aligner's thresholds will drop. 95% is
# the bar; a wrong reference or a broken index lands far below.
awk -v v="$PCTMAP" 'BEGIN{exit !(v>=95)}'
echo 'SMOKE CHECK PASSED'
